main.note: 084 optimum (scripts/foresight._pol), B_host = highest probe rate (the limit's); GPU shortfall as a rate, net, calibrated per cell

bhost_median.note: 084 optimum, B_host = median of the three zero-copy concurrent pairs (77.7 GB/s, the B_cp the engine's law sees for both paths)

gpu_const.note: GPU shortfall as a constant per token instead of a rate

gpu_gross.note: GPU rate from the all-in-VRAM run (RTX PRO 6000, same datasheet bandwidth); the overlap the engine achieves (delta) is credited to every non-overlapped state, so the paper's overlap and GPU steps shift by delta

split6.note: policy (engine's reads -> best online's) and read paths (probe law -> B_host) as separate fixes

exact_max.note: exact per-layer optimum (mosl.cachesim MIN with bypass, speed_limit_v2.json), B_host = max (87.5 GB/s); CPU/copy split of the optimum from the trace; GPU shortfall as a rate, net

exact_median.note: exact per-layer optimum (mosl.cachesim MIN with bypass, speed_limit_v2.json), B_host = median (80.7 GB/s); CPU/copy split of the optimum from the trace; GPU shortfall as a rate, net

exact_median_zc.note: exact per-layer optimum (mosl.cachesim MIN with bypass, speed_limit_v2.json), B_host = median_zc (77.7 GB/s); CPU/copy split of the optimum from the trace; GPU shortfall as a rate, net
